div.p: How we handle your data, the terms for using this website and its downloads, and the cookies we use. Last updated November 2026.

article.p: ARQORA Lighting S.r.l., Via Tortona 31, 20144 Milano, Italy (VAT IT 09876543210) is the controller of the personal data you share with us through this website.

When you send an enquiry we collect your name, email address, company, professional role, project type, project location, estimated requirements and your message. We do not collect payment details through this website.
We use your details only to answer your enquiry, prepare quotations and samples, and support your project. We never sell your data or share it with third parties for their own marketing.
Enquiry data is kept for up to 24 months after our last contact, or for as long as required by Italian tax and accounting law for confirmed orders.

You may ask to access, correct, export or delete your data, or object to its use, at any time by writing to privacy@arqora.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian data protection authority (Garante per la protezione dei dati personali).
All content on this website, including product designs, photographs, drawings and technical documentation, is the property of ARQORA Lighting S.r.l. or its licensors.

Specification sheets, CAD drawings, IES photometric files and installation manuals may be downloaded and used for the specification of ARQORA products in architectural and interior projects. They may not be resold or used to reproduce our designs.
Prices shown are indicative starting prices, exclude VAT and may vary by country, finish and configuration. A formal quotation confirms the price, lead time and delivery terms for your project.
We take care to keep product information accurate, but dimensions, finishes and technical data may change as products evolve. Please confirm critical values with our technical team before ordering.
This website uses only what it needs to work. We do not use advertising cookies, cross-site tracking or third-party analytics.

Nothing. The filters and sort order you choose in the catalogue are kept in the page address (URL), so you can bookmark or share a filtered view. No cookies are set and nothing is shared with us or with anyone else.
If we ever introduce cookies, this notice will be updated first and you will be able to accept or decline them.
